inlineContent.text: The Metal framework gives your app direct access to a device’s graphics processing unit (GPU). With Metal, apps can leverage a GPU to quickly render complex scenes and run computational tasks in parallel. For example, apps in these categories use Metal to maximize their performance:
Games that render sophisticated 2D or 3D environments
Video processing apps, like Final Cut Pro
Scientific research apps that analyze and process large datasets
Metal works hand-in-hand with other frameworks that supplement its capability. For example,
upscales your renderings in less time than rendering them natively, and
simplifies the tasks that display your Metal content onscreen. The
